What can melanoma be confused with?

text_blocks.snippet: Melanoma, a type of skin cancer, needs to be differentiated from various benign and malignant skin conditions that can mimic its appearance. Key considerations include distinguishing it from other pigmented lesions like moles (benign melanocytic nevi), dysplastic nevi, and pigmented basal cell carcinoma. Other conditions like dermatofibromas, seborrheic keratoses, and even vascular lesions like cherry hemangiomas can also be mistaken for melanoma.
